audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph gatekeepers, treasuries, and external administration, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for gatekeeping, fertility blessing, warrior language, lots, accessibility, treasury oversight, dedicated war spoil, religious-state administration, regional authority, and labor accountability.

verses.restored: Divisions of gatekeepers: from Korahites, Meshelemiah son of Kore from sons of Asaph/Ebiasaph.

familiar.text: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

modern.text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.

original.text: לְמַחְלְק֖וֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן קֹרֵ֖א מִן בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף

verses.restored: Sons of Meshelemiah: Zechariah firstborn, Jediael second, Zebadiah third, Jathniel fourth,

familiar.text: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

modern.text: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

original.text: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי

verses.restored: Elam fifth, Jehohanan sixth, Eliehoenai seventh.

familiar.text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

modern.text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

original.text: עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי

verses.restored: Sons of Obed-edom: Shemaiah firstborn, Jehozabad second, Joah third, Sacar fourth, Nethanel fifth,

familiar.text: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

modern.text: And Obed-edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

original.text: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי

verses.restored: Ammiel sixth, Issachar seventh, Peullethai eighth, for Divine blessed him.

familiar.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

modern.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.

original.text: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: To Shemaiah his son were born sons who ruled ancestral house, for they were mighty people of ability.

familiar.text: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

modern.text: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.

original.text: וְלִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנוֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: Sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, whose relatives Elihu and Semachiah were able people.

familiar.text: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

modern.text: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ

verses.restored: All these from sons of Obed-edom, they and sons and relatives, able with strength for service—sixty-two from Obed-edom.

familiar.text: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.

modern.text: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.

original.text: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם

verses.restored: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, able people—eighteen.

familiar.text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

modern.text: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.

original.text: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר

verses.restored: Hosah from sons of Merari had sons: Shimri the chief, though not firstborn, father made him chief;

familiar.text: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

modern.text: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),

original.text: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן בְּנֵי מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: Hilkiah second, Tebaliah third, Zechariah fourth. All sons and relatives of Hosah were thirteen.

familiar.text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

modern.text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.

original.text: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כָּל בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר

verses.restored: To these divisions of gatekeepers, chief people had duties corresponding to relatives to minister in house of YHWH.

familiar.text: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.

modern.text: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their brothers did.

original.text: לְ֠אֵלֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: They cast lots, small and great alike by ancestral house, for each gate.

familiar.text: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

modern.text: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.

original.text: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּד֛וֹל לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר

verses.restored: Lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. For Zechariah his son, a counselor with insight, they cast lots, and his lot came northward.

familiar.text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

modern.text: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.

original.text: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֨ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖וֹ צָפֽוֹנָה

verses.restored: For Obed-edom southward, and for sons the storehouse.

familiar.text: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

modern.text: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.

original.text: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים

verses.restored: For Shuppim and Hosah westward, at Shallecheth gate by ascending highway, watch beside watch.

familiar.text: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

modern.text: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.

original.text: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר

verses.restored: Eastward six Levites each day, northward four, southward four, and at storehouse two by two.

familiar.text: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

modern.text: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.

original.text: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפ֤וֹנָה לַיּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם

verses.restored: At colonnade westward, four at highway and two at colonnade.

familiar.text: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

modern.text: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.

original.text: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר

verses.restored: These were divisions of gatekeepers from Korahites and sons of Merari.

familiar.text: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

modern.text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari. The Treasurers, Officers, and Judges

original.text: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקָּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי

verses.restored: Levites—their relatives—were over treasuries of house of Divine and treasuries of dedicated things.

familiar.text: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

modern.text: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.

original.text: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Descendants of Ladan, Gershonites through Ladan, heads of ancestral houses: Jehieli.

familiar.text: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

modern.text: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי

verses.restored: Sons of Jehieli, Zetham and Joel his brother, were over treasuries of house of YHWH.

familiar.text: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.

modern.text: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

original.text: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: From Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and Uzzielites:

familiar.text: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

modern.text: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

original.text: לַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ לַיִּצְהָרִ֔י לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָֽעָזִּיאֵלִֽי

verses.restored: Shebuel son of Gershom son of Moses was ruler over treasuries.

familiar.text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

modern.text: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.

original.text: וּשְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל הָאֹצָרֽוֹת

verses.restored: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, Shelomoth his son.

familiar.text: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

modern.text: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

original.text: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ וִֽישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנוֹ֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ ושלמות בְּנֽוֹ

verses.restored: Shelomoth and relatives were over all treasuries of dedicated things that David the king, ancestral heads, commanders of thousands and hundreds, and army commanders had dedicated.

familiar.text: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

modern.text: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.

original.text: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כָּל אֹצְר֤וֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְשָׂרֵֽי הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא

verses.restored: From wars and spoil they dedicated things to maintain house of YHWH.

familiar.text: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.

modern.text: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.

original.text: מִן הַמִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּמִן הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: All Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah had dedicated—every dedicated thing was under hand of Shelomoth and relatives.

familiar.text: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

modern.text: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.

original.text: וְכֹ֨ל הַֽהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן נֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו

verses.restored: From Izharites, Chenaniah and sons were assigned to external business over Israel as officers and judges.

familiar.text: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

modern.text: From the Izrahites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.

original.text: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים

verses.restored: From Hebronites, Hashabiah and relatives, able people—one thousand seven hundred—had oversight west of Jordan for all work of YHWH and service of king.

familiar.text: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

modern.text: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.

original.text: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: From Hebronites, Jerijah was chief according to generations. In fortieth year of David's reign they were sought, and able people were found at Jazer of Gilead.

familiar.text: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

modern.text: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.

original.text: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָב֑וֹת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד

verses.restored: His relatives, able ancestral heads—two thousand seven hundred—David made overseers over Reubenites, Gadites, and half-Manasseh for every matter of Divine and matter of king.

familiar.text: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

modern.text: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.

original.text: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת וַיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכָל דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

translation_notes: Gatekeepers manage safety, access, property, and welcome; they should not become militarized bouncers or barriers to disabled and marginalized worshippers.
Obed-edom's many sons are called blessing, but fertility and number of children are not universal measures of Divine favor.
'Mighty' and 'able' should include reliability and skill, not only violent masculinity.
Lots distribute gates but do not guarantee fairness; accessibility, rotation, and oversight remain necessary.
Treasuries require transparent records, separation of duties, and protection against clerical or royal misuse.
War spoil dedicated to temple maintenance does not cleanse the violence or restore property to those from whom it was taken.
Samuel, Saul, Abner, Joab, and David all contribute to sacred treasury despite morally complex histories; donations do not purchase absolution.
External officers combine religious and royal matters, raising concerns about theocracy, policing, and institutional overreach.
Regional oversight across Jordan may reflect centralized control rather than local consent.
safety_note: Do not use gatekeeping to exclude, family size as blessing hierarchy, sacred treasury to launder war wealth, or religious officers as unaccountable police. Require accessibility, transparent finances, labor dignity, local voice, and separation of religious and coercive power.
